title: Tenure Track: Assistant Professor
industry: Economics, Economics and Social Sciences, General Economics (JEL A), Finance
text:
We seek outstanding scholars who are passionate about advancing the field of finance through impactful research, dynamic teaching, and meaningful service. The successful candidate will be expected to:
Conduct and publish high-quality research in leading academic journals,
Deliver engaging, rigorous instruction at the undergraduate, master’s, and/or doctoral levels, and
Contribute to the department, school, and university through professional service and outreach.
The Adam C. Sinn ’00 Department of Finance fosters a collegial, collaborative, and research-driven environment, providing exceptional resources and support to help faculty achieve excellence in research, teaching, and professional growth.
Qualifications
A Ph.D. in Finance or related discipline is required. Candidates from all areas of finance, as well as candidates with a Ph.D. in Economics (or a related field) working in finance, are encouraged to apply. Preference will be given to applicants with demonstrated potential for publishing in top-tier finance and related journals.
Application Instructions
We will begin reviewing candidates immediately and continue reviewing as applications are received and until the position is filled.
Interested applicants must apply through the Texas A&M University faculty job board hosted by Interfolio at apply.interfolio.com/188161 and upload the following: 
1) Curriculum Vitae 
2) Cover Letter 
3) Job Market Paper 
4) Personal Statement: Personal statement to include philosophy and plans for research, teaching, and service, as applicable 
5) Three confidential letters of recommendation, submitted via Interfolio
For questions about the position, please contact: Professor Wei Wu
Email: wwu@mays.tamu.edu
Application Process
This institution is using Interfolio's Faculty Search to conduct this search. Applicants to this position receive a free Dossier account and can send all application materials, including confidential letters of recommendation, free of charge.
